# Add a route to apps/web

Conventions live in `apps/web/AGENTS.md`; read it first. This file is only the ordering that matters.

**Plan around this:** `apps/web/src/route-tree.ts` is generated by the `tanstackRouter` plugin in
`apps/web/vite.config.ts`, and **only the user regenerates it**. Until they do, `tsc` fails on your
new file with:

```
error TS2345: Argument of type '"/_app/your-route"' is not assignable to parameter of type 'keyof FileRoutesByPath | undefined'.
```

That error is the expected state of a correct new route, not a bug to fix. Never hand-edit
`route-tree.ts` and never run the generator.

## Steps

1. **Choose the filename** under `apps/web/src/routes/`. The path on disk _is_ the URL.

   | Filename              | Gives                                                                                                                |
   | --------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
   | `_app/foo.tsx`        | `/foo` — `_app/` is a pathless layout and contributes no segment                                                     |
   | `_app/foo/index.tsx`  | `/foo`                                                                                                               |
   | `_app/foo/route.tsx`  | the layout wrapping everything under `/foo`                                                                          |
   | `_app/foo/$barId.tsx` | `/foo/$barId`                                                                                                        |
   | `_app/foo.bar.tsx`    | `/foo/bar` — **a `.` is a path separator**, not a name part (a TanStack convention this repo does not currently use) |

   Ordinary segments are kebab-case. Put it under `_app/` unless it must render without auth;
   `_app/route.tsx` is what redirects unauthenticated users.

2. **Write the file.** `_app/admin/branding/login-page.tsx` is the minimal shape;
   `_app/admin/audit/logs.tsx` is the full one (search params, loader, nested components). Read one
   before writing. Components go above, `export const Route = createFileRoute(...)` last.

3. **Make the `createFileRoute` literal match the file path exactly**, including the leading `/_app`
   — `createFileRoute('/_app/admin/audit/logs')` for `_app/admin/audit/logs.tsx`. It is a literal,
   not a template; a mismatch is the TS2345 above.

4. **If the route reads search params, add `validateSearch`** with a Zod schema — either one from
   `@opendatacapture/schemas` (`logs.tsx`) or an inline `z.object` (`_app/upload/$instrumentId.tsx`).
   Without it, `Route.useSearch()` has nothing to return.

5. **If the loader depends on search params, `loaderDeps` must be written before `loader`**, with the
   disable comment, exactly as in `logs.tsx`:

   ```ts
   loaderDeps: ({ search }) => ({ search }),
   // eslint-disable-next-line perfectionist/sort-objects
   loader: async ({ context, deps }) => { ... }
   ```

   `perfectionist/sort-objects` would sort `loader` first, and then `deps` is inferred as `{}` —
   `deps.search` fails with `TS2339: Property 'search' does not exist on type '{}'`.

6. **Prefetch in the loader** with `context.queryClient.ensureQueryData(<hook>QueryOptions(...))`,
   using the `queryOptions` factory the hook exports so the key matches. The component then calls the
   hook. If the hook does not exist yet, `.agents/docs/playbooks/add-web-data-hook.md`.

7. **Add a `data-testid`** to whatever the e2e test will click or assert on. These are the Playwright
   suite's selectors.

8. **If the route needs a nav entry, add it to `apps/web/src/hooks/useNavItems.ts`**, guarded by the
   right `ability.can(...)`. `NavItem.url` is typed `url?: string`, so a wrong URL there compiles and 404s
   at runtime — copy it from your `createFileRoute` literal.

9. **Put nothing else in `src/routes/`.** Tests go in `apps/web/src/__tests__/`, helpers in
   `src/components/` or `src/utils/`. Importing `vitest` or `@testing-library/*` from `src/routes/`
   is an eslint error.

10. **Ask the user to regenerate the route tree** (it happens when they run `pnpm dev` for `web`).
    Steps 11 and 12, and `pnpm lint`, cannot pass before this.

11. **Regenerate the test suite's route union:** `pnpm --filter @opendatacapture/testing gen:routes`.
    It parses `FileRouteTypes['to']` out of `route-tree.ts` into the git-ignored
    `testing/src/generated/route.d.ts`. The new route literal does not exist for `getPageModel` or
    the `pageModels` map until this runs. You may run this one yourself.

12. **Add the tests.** A unit test under `apps/web/src/__tests__/`, and an e2e test —
    `.agents/docs/playbooks/add-e2e-test.md`, which covers the page object and registering it in
    `testing/src/support/fixtures.ts`.

## Verify

```sh
pnpm --filter @opendatacapture/web lint          # tsc && eslint --fix src
pnpm exec vitest --project web
pnpm --filter @opendatacapture/testing gen:routes
pnpm test:e2e
```

`pnpm --filter @opendatacapture/web lint` failing with TS2345 on your route file means only that the
route tree has not been regenerated yet.
